test_runs.boundary: Mostly unit tests with mocks/stubs (including Prisma, fetch/provider and Redis dependencies). The opt-in PostgreSQL lexical integration suite (1 suite/5 tests) was skipped because LEXICAL_INDEX_INTEGRATION was not enabled. DATABASE_URL was forced to a dummy localhost database and DATABASE_URL_APP unset; no real PostgreSQL, Redis, model provider, Feishu or production service integration ran.
Local parser tests and ASGITransport requests; startup tests briefly launch a localhost subprocess. No production/parser service or external provider was accessed.

function_reproductions.candidate: Feishu syncAcl stops after first raw download failure
function_reproductions.method: Real FeishuConnector.fetchChanges with mocked token, listing, ACL and raw-download responses; no Feishu network call.
function_reproductions.observed: With files a,b and a raw download returning HTTP 403, result contained only a aclOnly change with externalAcl.verified=false; nextCursor was null; snapshotIds contained [a,b]. Calls included permissions/a and raw/a, with no request for b. ConnectorService ingest treats the aclOnly change as skipped, so it does not increment failed and finalizes the run as success.

function_reproductions.candidate: QA source binding lost by DocumentVersionController.publishVersion
function_reproductions.observed: publishVersion omits parserMetadata when calling createVersion, but QA versions copy the original rawFileOid JSON and enqueue parsing. IngestionService parses sourceType=qa directly from that JSON, puts parsed.qa into parserMetadata.qa, and DocumentVersionStore publicationData writes parserMetadata back to Document. Normal sourceDocumentId/sourceVersionId binding is restored.

function_reproductions.candidate: Graph projection merges Alpha/alpha identity but drops second raw-case edge
function_reproductions.method: Real graphProjection function with in-memory document shards.
function_reproductions.observed: Same-type Alpha and alpha become one Alpha node. keysByName retains the first raw spelling Alpha; the alpha relation cannot resolve its source and is deleted. Output contains only doc-a relation provenance.

function_reproductions.candidate: Graph projection cross-type relation merged by shared surface label
function_reproductions.method: Real graphProjection function with Mercury(planet)/Mercury(element), shared X(concept), and same relation type.
function_reproductions.observed: Output has one Mercury(planet)-has->X edge with inputs from doc-a and doc-b and provenance chunks from both documents. The element relation is incorrectly attributed to the planet edge.
